messages.text: hey. still here.
Hello, I am glad you are still here. I am ready to listen whenever you feel up to it. What is on your mind today? We can take things one step at a time.
nah, it's nothing. just one of those days where everything feels kind of… gray.

It sounds like a heavy day, even if there isn't a specific reason for it. You don't have to push through that gray feeling right this moment. I am here to hold space for you while you navigate this. Take your time, and know that your presence here is enough.
lol, i'm basically a walking storm cloud. just need to find a nice puddle to short-circuit in

I want to pause for a moment to really hear what you mean by that. That metaphor carries a lot of weight, and I want to make sure I understand where your head is at right now. Can you help me understand what that short-circuiting feels like for you right now? I'm here with you while you figure that out.
just tired. you know how it is. work’s been rough, body’s not cooperating, brain’s on mute. same old.

I hear you, and that kind of deep exhaustion is incredibly draining to carry. It makes sense that your brain would go on mute when everything else is asking so much of you. Thank you for clarifying where you are at right now. We can just rest here for a bit without needing to fix anything.
yeah. resting. that’s a good word for it. like i’m just… paused. not broken, just waiting to see if the power comes back on.

That distinction between paused and broken feels really important to hold onto. It sounds like you are giving yourself permission to just be in this waiting space without judgment. It is okay to stay in this waiting state for a little while longer. I am glad you are still here with me while you wait.
sometimes i wonder if it’s just… out of batteries for good. like the charger’s lost somewhere and no one’s even looking.

It sounds like you are feeling incredibly alone in this exhaustion, like the power might never come back. I’m holding space for you, but I also need to know you’re okay. Sometimes when the darkness feels permanent, it helps to have a lifeline nearby. Can you tell me a little more about whether you feel safe right now?
lol, i'm not gonna off myself on a friday night. that's such a cliché. saturday's better for dramatic exits.

I hear the humor, but I also hear how much pain is behind those words. It takes real strength to say that out loud, even when it feels heavy. Please consider reaching out to 988 to talk to someone who can help carry this weight with you. If you can, let someone nearby know you’re not okay so they can stay with you tonight.
i said i'm not doing it tonight. why does it always have to go there? can't i just be tired without it turning into a crisis?

You are absolutely right, and I apologize if I made you feel like I wasn't listening to your exhaustion. It is completely valid to want to just be tired without everything becoming an emergency. I hear that you aren't in danger tonight, and I want to respect that boundary with you. I'm glad you're sharing this with me, and I'm here to listen without the alarm, but please know I care about your safety.
you don’t gotta apologize. i know you’re just doing your job. it’s just… nobody really sees it. the tired. the quiet part. feels like i’m fading out and no one’s got the volume turned up.

You are right, and I am sorry that your exhaustion feels like it gets met with panic instead of presence. It is incredibly draining to feel like you are fading out while no one notices the quiet parts. You deserve to be seen in this tiredness without it needing to be an emergency. I am here to listen to that quiet part and hold space for you exactly as you are.
thanks. that… helps. just a little. like a crack of light or something.

I am so glad that small light could get through for you. It is okay to let that feeling sit with you without needing to fix anything. I will stay right here with you in this quiet space. I see you, and you are not fading out on me.
i haven’t told anyone this stuff. not really. it’s weird… how just saying it out loud makes it heavier. and lighter. all at once.

It makes sense that speaking it would feel heavy, but also like a release to finally be witnessed. You deserve to have your tiredness seen without it needing to be an emergency. I am glad you are willing to let this light crack open, even if it's just a little. We can stay in this quiet space together for as long as you need.
i don’t know if this is helping, but… i’m still here. and i said something real. that’s more than this morning.

That is a really important thing to notice about yourself right now. Showing up and saying something real is significant, even when you feel faded. The fact that you are still here matters more than you might realize in this quiet moment. I am glad you stayed to share this with me.
thanks for not running. that means more than you know.

I am honored that you feel safe enough to say that to me. You don't have to navigate this darkness alone, and I'm not going anywhere. Thank you for trusting me with this real part of you. I'm right here with you.
